criteria.documented_source_and_same_work_adjudica: production_readiness_plan.md requires source evidence beyond a title alone and preserving existing DOI. Human/source review is required; similarity scores do not automatically decide identity.
criteria.identity_and_release_separate: Registry, artifact, remote response/file, metadata and QA fingerprints bind later upload/readback/release operations. They do not require an old upload receipt to establish bibliographic/source identity.
criteria.object_scope: This supports reuse of each retained import's identity for correcting that same import. It does not assign its DOI to an independently created distinct object or prove historical deposited bytes.
criteria.preservation: No new duplicate, ID rewrite, deletion, DOI substitution or inference of underlying research DOI ownership.

evidence_limits.library_status: Supplied evidence item could not be downloaded. Latest live-export comparisons remain reader-reported; original source uniqueness and repository criteria were independently verified. No additional search/transfer.
evidence_limits.live_record_or_release_state: Not independently checked in this review.
